title: A.R.M.O.R. electrical readings of one node
description: What an ARMOR-ELECTRICAL node measures on the house's electrical network: one entry per measured channel (a circuit, a line, the grid input, a DC bus) and, when the node has them, the state of its switches. Published to armor/electrical/{node_id}/state. It carries states, never a command: what a switch was asked to do travels in electrical_command.schema.json and what the node answered in electrical_result.schema.json.

switching_enabled.description: Whether the node's firmware is allowed to switch anything at all (it is off unless it was built and set up to allow it).

power_w.description: Positive when the channel draws power from the network, negative when it feeds it.

energy_kwh.description: The energy that has flowed through the channel since the meter was last reset.

state.description: For a channel that has a switch: what the node sees, not what it was asked.

switches.description: The switches the node controls (a source transfer: two contactors onto one line). Absent on a node that only measures. What each says is what the auxiliary contacts show, never what was asked.

kind.description: Two sources, A and B, each behind a contactor, onto one line; never both.

source_a.description: The id of the channel that measures source A.

source_b.description: The id of the channel that measures source B.

a_closed.description: The auxiliary contact of A's contactor: true = confirmed closed.

b_closed.description: The auxiliary contact of B's contactor: true = confirmed closed.

selected.description: The source that is confirmed closed onto the line (none while opening, closing or open).

wanted.description: The source the controller is trying to reach (none = open).

closing.description: A coil is energised and the contact has not yet confirmed.

armed.description: The next request to close is accepted (a short window that one request consumes).

fault.description: A latched fault opens everything until it is acknowledged with both contactors confirmed open.
